title: DDM1 safeguards the stability of a Complex plant genome
content: DNA methylation, a conserved epigenetic mechanism studied in both animals and plants, is associated with control of gene expression, development, stress response, transposable element (TE) silencing, and genome stability (Schmitz et al. 2019). In plants, TE silencing is of particular interest, as DNA methylation is largely associated with transposons and other repetitive sequences.
